text.text: Two grains meet with no transition: pre-reclamation lanes to the south, orthogonal port land to the north.
Almost every residential block repeats one section: commercial at ground, residential above. No workspace or civic floor appears anywhere, so activity collapses into shopping and sleeping.
Bus routes run along the perimeter road; none enter the area. The nearest stop is 350 m from the organic core. Internal movement depends entirely on private motorcycles.
MPL cargo handling, warehouses and truck movements sit directly against low-rise housing. No buffer, no setback, no change in street section.
4 Beyond walking distance of daily needs
Among the furthest points in Malé from a mosque or school. Nearest mosque 250 m, nearest school 450 m on foot. Daily needs require a trip out of the area.
Apart from the perimeter road, carriageways measure under 5 m, set out for foot traffic. They now carry parked motorcycles, deliveries and pedestrians in one section, with no footpath.
